items.title: Register as job-seeking with the Agentur für Arbeit
items.quote: Um Nachteile beim Arbeitslosengeld zu vermeiden, müssen Sie sich sofort bei der Agentur für Arbeit arbeitsuchend melden.
items.computation: The letter was handed over in person on 18.11.2026 (witnessed), so that is the date Ute Beispielberger learned of the termination date (31.01.2027). Under § 38 Abs. 1 Satz 2 SGB III, if the end date is known less than three months before it occurs (18.11.2026 to 31.01.2027 is only about 2 months 13 days, i.e. less than 3 months), the job-seeking registration must be made within three days of gaining knowledge of the end date. Day of event (18.11.2026) is not counted (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB analogy); counting 19.11 (day 1), 20.11 (day 2), 21.11 (day 3). 21.11.2026 is a Saturday, so under the weekend/holiday extension rule (§ 26 Abs. 3 SGB X analogy, § 193 BGB) the deadline moves to the next working day, Monday 23.11.2026.

items.title: File Kündigungsschutzklage (unfair-dismissal action) at the Labour Court
items.quote: Eine Klage gegen diese Kündigung wäre innerhalb von drei Wochen nach Erhalt des Schreibens beim Arbeitsgericht einzureichen.
items.computation: Under § 4 KSchG, an unfair-dismissal action must be filed within three weeks of receipt (Zugang) of the written notice. Receipt occurred on the day of personal handover, 18.11.2026 (Wednesday), confirmed by a witness. The day of receipt is not counted (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB); the three-week period ends on the day with the same weekday three weeks later (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB): 18.11.2026 + 21 days = 09.12.2026 (Wednesday). 09.12.2026 is not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in Rheinland-Pfalz, so no extension applies.

items.title: Employment relationship ends
items.quote: Wir kündigen deshalb das Arbeitsverhältnis ordentlich unter Einhaltung der gesetzlichen Frist zum 31.01.2027.
items.computation: The letter states the termination date explicitly as 31.01.2027; this is a fixed calendar date and is used as written.

warnings: The statutory three-day deadline to register as job-seeking with the Agentur für Arbeit (to avoid reductions in Arbeitslosengeld) fell on 23.11.2026, which is already in the past relative to today (24.11.2026); if this has not yet been done, contact the Agentur für Arbeit immediately and explain the short delay, as late registration can still reduce benefits.

The applicability of the weekend-extension rule to the SGB III three-day job-seeking deadline is not fully settled in case law for this exact scenario, so the 23.11.2026 date should be treated as the latest safe estimate rather than an absolute certainty.
